items.source: Spring AI supports the new moderation service introduced by Mistral AI and powered by the Mistral Moderation model. It enables the detection of harmful text content along several policy dimensions. Follow this link for more information on the Mistral AI moderation model.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持 Mistral AI 推出的新内容审核服务，该服务由 Mistral Moderation 模型驱动。它能够在多个策略维度上检测有害文本内容。有关 Mistral AI 内容审核模型的更多信息，请遵循此链接。

items.source: There has been a significant change in the Spring AI auto-configuration, starter modules' artifact names. Please refer to the upgrade notes for more information.
items.translation: Spring AI 的自动配置中，starter 模块的构件名称已发生重大变更。 有关更多信息，请参阅升级说明。

要启用该功能，请将以下依赖添加到项目的 Maven `pom.xml` 文件中：

items.source: Enabling and disabling of the moderation auto-configurations are now configured via top level properties with the prefix spring.ai.model.moderation.
items.translation: 启用和禁用审核自动配置现在通过带有前缀spring.ai.model.moderation的顶层属性进行配置。

items.source: The MistralAiModerationModelIT test provides some general examples of how to use the library. You can refer to this test for more detailed usage examples.
items.translation: <MistralAiModerationModelIT>测试提供了一些如何使用该库的通用示例。您可以参考此测试以获取更详细的使用示例。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.mistralai is used as the property prefix that lets you connect to Mistral AI.
items.translation: 前缀 spring.ai.mistralai 用作属性前缀，使您能够连接到 Mistral AI。

items.source: To enable, spring.ai.model.moderation=mistral (It is enabled by default)
items.translation: 要启用该功能，请设置 spring.ai.model.moderation=mistral（默认已启用）。

items.source: To disable, spring.ai.model.moderation=none (or any value which doesn’t match mistral)
items.translation: 要禁用该功能，请将 spring.ai.model.moderation 设置为 none（或任何不匹配 mistral 的值）。

items.source: This change is done to allow configuration of multiple models.
items.translation: 此更改旨在支持配置多个模型。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.mistralai.moderation is used as the property prefix for configuring the Mistral AI moderation model.
items.translation: spring.ai.mistralai.moderation 前缀用作配置 Mistral AI 内容审核模型的属性前缀。

items.source: Enable Moderation model
items.translation: 启用审核模型

items.source: ID of the model to use for moderation.
items.translation: 用于审核的模型 ID。

items.source:
The MistralAiModerationOptions class provides the options to use when making a moderation request.
On start-up, the options specified by spring.ai.mistralai.moderation are used, but you can override these at runtime.

items.source: You can override the common spring.ai.mistralai.base-url, spring.ai.mistralai.api-key, properties. The spring.ai.mistralai.moderation.base-url, spring.ai.mistralai.moderation.api-key, properties, if set, take precedence over the common properties. This is useful if you want to use different Mistral AI accounts for different models and different model endpoints.
items.translation: 您可以覆盖通用的 spring.ai.mistralai.base-url 和 spring.ai.mistralai.api-key 属性。如果设置了 spring.ai.mistralai.moderation.base-url 和 spring.ai.mistralai.moderation.api-key 属性，它们将优先于通用属性生效。如果您希望为不同的模型使用不同的 Mistral AI 账户以及不同的模型端点，此功能非常有用。
